## What's changed

- Added media probing for prepared Discovery streams so playback planning uses
  the actual container, resolution, codecs, audio tracks, and HDR format.
- Correctly converts demanding 4K HDR and Dolby Vision video for lower-resolution
  SDR players instead of treating an unknown Discovery source as direct-play SDR.
- Preserves compatible source audio when only the video needs conversion, including
  multichannel Dolby Digital Plus on capable Tater Tube Player devices.
- Added a conservative release-name fallback for common resolution, HDR, video,
  and audio tags when a prepared stream cannot be probed in time.
